seo.title: Furkan Baytekin | The Open Sourcerer - Fullstack Developer
seo.description: Software developer & open sourcerer. builds systems from architecture to production, modular monoliths, multitenant platforms on minimal infrastructure.

data.name: Furkan Baytekin
data.bio: I'm a Software Developer who has an educational background, so I can teach you how to code. I also describe myself as an open sourcerer. I play the bass guitar and keen on reading books. I obsessed with vinyl records and retro stuff (to get away from the software for a bit).

items.title: Game Jams
items.description: Game jams are my way of unwinding. I compose and record soundtracks with bass and electric guitars and a MIDI keyboard — and occasionally go full solo as both dev and musician.

items.title: Playing Electro & Bass Guitar
items.description: I've been playing the bass guitar since 2017. I like to compose and play music on my own.

items.title: Reading Books
items.description: I read books to get away from the software for a bit, but I always end up reading about software.

items.title: Collecting Vinyl Records
items.description: I'm obsessed with vinyl records. I have a collection of vinyl records and the oldest one is from 1969 original pressing.
